issues: Still gated on dina_tour_done_${user.id} — automated tests must GET /api/auth/me first to seed. Pre-existing from iter24+.

critical_code_review_comments: ProductFormV3 size options are hard-coded to isShoe check on category name (keywords 'chaussure/mule/sandale'). If a new category 'Bottines' is added, the sizes revert to CLOTH_SIZES. Consider explicit 'size_system' per category (shoe/cloth/one-size) stored in the Category model.

VariantsGrid emit() keeps only enabled variants in the output array — this is correct for storage but means toggling off a cell loses its stock value. UX-wise, consider preserving disabled rows for easy re-enable (currently user must re-input stock on re-enable). Non-blocking.
VideoUpload.probeDuration() does not timeout — if a corrupt file never fires loadedmetadata or error, the upload hangs with loading=true. Add a setTimeout fallback (e.g., 5s → resolve 0).

VideoUpload MIME regex `/^video\/(mp4|quicktime|mov)/i` accepts 'video/mov' which is not a real MIME type (browsers emit 'video/quicktime' for .mov). Harmless but misleading in the error message 'Format accepté : MP4 ou MOV'.

Product.jsx line 39-40 preselects size=sizes[0] and color=colors[0] even when hasRealVariants(p) is true — if (sizes[0],colors[0]) is not a valid combo, user sees stockForSize=0 and 'canAdd=false' on page load. Suggest preselecting from the first enabled variant: e.g. setSize(firstEnabledVariant.size); setColor(firstEnabledVariant.color).

server.py ProductIn uses `List[Dict[str, Any]]` for variants without a nested Pydantic model — no server-side validation that each entry has {size,color,enabled,stock}. Add VariantIn(BaseModel) for safety.
